versions.content: Inheritance in the AUTOSAR XML Schema Inheritance in the AUTOSAR meta-model is mapped to XML schema by the following mechanisms: • For each class in the AUTOSAR meta-model groups are created which contain the XML-elements and XML-attributes that represent the properties that are di- rectly defined by the class. Classes without properties with xml.attribute=false will result in empty groups. • Additionally an xsd:complexType representing the full content of the concrete class is created. The structure of this xsd:complexType is defined by referencing the group that defines the properties of the class itself and the xsd:groups that define the properties of the super-classes. The group representing the most gen- eral class (root of inheritance tree) is referenced first. The group representing the class itself is referenced last.
